title: feat: make local model profiles runtime-aware
body:
## P3 follow-up — Full Model Library

Stacked after PR #23 (`completion/advanced-arena-followup`); PRs #17–#23 remain draft.

- preserves Ollama, LM Studio, and llama.cpp/GGUF identity in immutable profile revisions and effective run configuration
- makes runtime-specific download/removal capabilities explicit in the UI; no unsupported remote download is invented
- blocks managed-model removal while an operation is queued/running and retains persisted progress/cancellation/removal audit
- keeps loopback-only discovery, bounded GGUF paths, duplicate grouping, and quantization-distinct records
- validated by canonical BL4 app_server: 81 TypeScript tests, 103 Rust tests, typecheck, Vite build, cargo fmt/check, and diff checks

P3 remains IN PROGRESS pending real native runtime acceptance and remaining security/publication gates.

No merge, tag, release, deploy, or public release is included.
